entities.summary: Esraa Elsayed Rashed Elsayed Ahmed is an Egyptian weightlifter. At the 2016 Summer Olympics she competed in the Women's 63 kg. She won silver medals at the 2013 Mediterranean Games in the 58 kg event, and at the 2015 African Games in the 63 kg event.
